interface.title: dms-viz (v0.8.6)
interface.field: Protein biochemistry / virology: deep mutational scanning (antibody escape mapping)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and presenting results after analysis: site-level mutation effects are explored, compared and exported as figures
interface.what_it_is_for: Explore site-level deep mutational scanning scores along a protein sequence in linked plots and map selected sites onto the protein's 3D structure, comparing conditions or antibodies.

data.note: The built-in example loads on its own: escape from the Regeneron anti-RBD antibody cocktail, with conditions REGN10933 and REGN10987 and sites 331 to 531. The same example.json was also loaded through Local upload, and as a Remote URL at http://127.0.0.1:5173/v0/data/example.json. The 3D structure never loaded. Every time, the page showed 'Failed to load protein: (error loading file: 'network error')', because the browser cannot reach files.rcsb.org.

tree.general: See where along a protein, and in which conditions, mutations change a measured property, map the chosen positions onto the protein's 3D structure, and save figures of it
tree.specific: Explore antibody-escape scores for the REGN cocktail across RBD sites, compare REGN10933 with REGN10987, highlight selected sites on the NGL structure (not reached in this run: the structure failed to load from files.rcsb.org), and export plot and protein images

screens_never_reached: The 3D protein structure view (NGL). It would not load: 'Failed to load protein: (error loading file: 'network error')', because the browser cannot reach files.rcsb.org. So I never saw selected sites highlighted on the structure.
Documentation and Examples pages: they link to dms-viz.github.io, outside the allowed host.
not_done: Seeing brushed or selected sites highlighted on the 3D structure (README goal): no structure loaded.
Seeing the legend's selected condition applied to the structure: no structure loaded.
Hovering or clicking residues on the structure to read their values: no structure loaded.

Checking what Protein Options do: I set Protein Representation to surface, Protein Color to #4a90d9 and lowered Protein Opacity, but with no structure nothing was drawn. Setting surface did produce a warning that the selection may be obscured (screens/025.webp, screens/026.webp). I did not try the Selection, Peripheral or Ligand representations, Show Ligands, Show Nucleotides, Show Non-Carbon Hydrogens, or colour-by-element.
Getting a meaningful protein image: Download Protein Image saved a 116 KB PNG, but it can only show an empty viewer.
Opening the downloaded PNGs: the browser tools only report their size.
Switching between datasets in the Dataset dropdown: the example has only one ('REGN mAb Cocktail'). The dropdown matters when a file holds several datasets.
Filtering on dataset-defined columns: data that defines filter columns (filter_cols) adds sliders under Filter Sites; the example offers only Mutation Coverage.
Preparing the input JSON with configure_dms_viz: this happens outside the app and was not tried.
Deselecting one site: clicking site 499 again left it looking selected (screens/046.webp), so I could not confirm whether a single click deselects. Double-click clears all sites.
Whether clicking a further point adds to or replaces the selection, and what Shift-click does: this run showed added sites, the replay saw a replacement and did not try Shift-click.
